sonnet.problem: The story card says two and a half tribes already have their land across the Jordan, toward the sunrise. That hints at the answer to the next choice card (card 13), which asks whether all six cities are in Canaan. It also adds an outside fact that isn't needed.
sonnet.rule: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later.

sonnet.problem: The card is a broken sentence. It starts with "If someone suddenly pushes..." and ends "...but the one who did it was no enemy and never meant any harm." It never finishes the thought, so it doesn't read correctly.
sonnet.rule: Clear English. Every card reads correctly.

sonnet.problem: Card 10 already asked that the manslayer must live in the city of refuge until the high priest dies. Card 13 asks the same fact again from the other side, that he may return home after the high priest dies.
sonnet.rule: An easy follow-up asks something new. It never re-asks the same fact.
